Title: Welcome to my portfolio website
subtitle: This is the portfolio of Dylan ter Bruggen
LinkedinText: Yes I have a LinkedIn profile but it is no longer in use. Because LinkedIn blocks my access I do not know why and LinkedIn support is worthless. and their automatic system requires multiple ID documents that I do not have. So I decided not to use my LinkedIn profile anymore. it still exists because I cannot close it because I cannot access it. The information on my LinkedIn profile is therefore no longer applicable
